<h1 class="h1">Machine Learning</h1>
<p class="role">ES 335 · IIT Gandhinagar · Semester I, 2024–25</p>
<p class="lede" style="margin-top:18px">The August 2024 offering of ES 335. Its 33 lectures run from decision trees and linear models through optimisation, classification and neural networks to unsupervised learning and support vector machines. Every lecture links its slides and notebooks.</p>

<div class="two rule-top">
<section id="faq"><h2>Questions</h2>
<details class="q" id="project"><summary>Is there a final project?</summary><p>No separate one. Each assignment has a project-like question instead, the same for everyone, so the added structure helps you get started and you learn the ideas by applying them.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="prereqs"><summary>What are the prerequisites?</summary><p>Python programming with data structures (ES 242 or equivalent), probability and statistics, linear algebra and calculus. The <a href="exams/prereq.html">prerequisite test</a> checks these; you must clear it to take the course.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="missed-quiz"><summary>What if I miss a quiz?</summary><p>A missed quiz scores zero and there are no makeups. The best three of four quizzes count, which is designed for such cases.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="assignment-grading"><summary>How are assignments graded?</summary><p>Assignments are done in groups and followed by a viva. Marks are split between code functionality, your understanding, code quality and theory. See <a href="assessment.html#assignment-marks">Assignment marks</a>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="laptops"><summary>Can I use my laptop in class?</summary><p>No. Laptops are not allowed in class for any reason.</p></details>
<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:12px"><a href="faq.html">All questions</a> · or ask on <a href="https://join.slack.com/t/es-335-fall-2024/shared_invite/zt-2mz08i9ur-uSgTNgmNsfmXnfjCTNPnew">the course Slack</a>.</p>
</section>
